g.text: ATMOSPHERIC OVERHEAD SYSTEM, STABILISER & NAPHTHA SPLITTER
1. D-102 pressure by split range: PV-1032A off-gas to FG/FGR, PV-1032B fuel gas make-up.
2. C-105 pressure by hot-vapour bypass PV-1091; C-106 by flooded condenser PV-1100.
3. Reboiler duties set by sensitive-tray temperature cascades (TIC-1095, TIC-1104).
4. Stream numbers (diamonds) refer to H&MB CFU-000-PR-HMB-001; data from design case, normal operation.
5. Pressures bar(g) unless noted. Pumps A/B are 2 x 100 %; only duty pump shown.
